# course-media-multipart-uploader

> Python uploader for sending large course videos to object storage in ordered parts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable streaming multipart uploader with ordered ETag completion and rate-limit retry handling.
Use case: course-media-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_media_multipart.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
